summary: Easterwood Field serves the Bryan-College Station metropolitan area in east-central Texas, home to Texas A&M University. The airport is named after local aviation enthusiast Frank Easterwood and operates as a regional gateway connecting the Brazos Valley to larger hub airports. It combines scheduled commercial service with general aviation operations on a single convenient campus.
faqs:
Q: What airlines serve Easterwood Field?
A: United Express provides scheduled commercial service, with nonstop flights primarily to Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport.

Q: How far is the airport from Texas A&M University?
A: The airport is located approximately 3 miles southwest of the Texas A&M main campus, typically a 10-15 minute drive.

Q: Does the airport offer rental car services?
A: Yes, on-site rental car counters are available in the terminal for major brands.

Q: Is parking available at the airport?
A: Yes, both short-term and long-term parking lots are available adjacent to the terminal building.
transport_tips: The airport sits just off Highway 6 and University Drive, making it a quick drive from both downtown College Station and the Texas A&M campus. Rideshare services and local taxis operate at the terminal, though availability can be limited during late-night or very early morning
